# Configuration · what to edit

[Project home](../README.md) · [Folder guide](project_structure.md)

[Illustrated Hill-type muscle: excitation, activation, elastic tendon, passive force, damping and pennation, with a per-muscle parameter selector.](muscle_model.md)

<a name="calibration-guide-link"></a>

**Before interpreting the results:** [What was calibrated: experimental EMG, fitted excitation, mechanical parameters and the forward calculation](calibration_summary.md).

Edit a value, save the file and run `run.py` again. Nothing is automatically fitted during the trial. The resulting folder includes the copied configuration, waveform, input hashes and model read-back values.

| File in Data/Model_Parameters | Controls |
| --- | --- |
| muscle_tendon.py | Maximum isometric tendon force, optimal fiber/slack tendon lengths, pennation, tendon strain, force curves and damping. |
| activation.py | Activation/deactivation constants and switching smoothness. |
| bodies.py / joints.py | Mass, center of mass, inertia, segment placement, axes, limits, stiffness and damping. |
| attachments.py / routing.py / wrapping.py | Origins, insertions, via sites, source pulley geometry and wrap surfaces. Positions are in the named local bone frame. |
| contact.py | Each pad’s radius, placement, normal stiffness, dissipation, shear stiffness/damping and friction. |
| initial_state.py | Only t=0: posture, velocity, activation, fiber length and pad shear state. |
| environment.py / simulation_settings.py | Gravity, solver, integration step, sample interval, duration and comparison scales. |
| formulation_constants.py / numerical_parameters.py | Shared curve-law constants, length/force tolerances, Newton safeguards and fall criteria. |

## How to read the parameter tables

**Source value** is the verified number from the author’s original work or cited literature, in the listed units. **Value used in this model** is the number actually applied in the simulation. **What changed and why** identifies the difference and documented reason. If the source is unavailable, the table explicitly says “Not established”; that value is an assumption, estimate or fitted value.

[Read the scientific source-to-model comparison](parameter_tables.md) · [Download the same values as CSV](../Data/Model_Parameters/model_parameter_values.csv).

## Inspecting the excitation input

The prescribed dimensionless cycle is in [excitation_cycle.tsv](../Data/Muscle_Excitation_Input/excitation_cycle.tsv). The channel dictionary identifies each muscle. The input is fixed before the simulation. Parameter edits are applied only by computing a new trial.

## Changing an attachment

Use ATTACHMENT_MAP.html to locate the site’s bone and local frame. An edited site moves with that bone. Changing it changes the routed MT length and its derivatives (moment arms), then force equilibrium and moments. For source pulley paths, routing.py is authoritative; edit its named radii/angles consistently rather than moving a dynamically recomputed tangent site. Wrapping is analytic/native; it does not collide muscles against a detailed mesh surface.
